text:
maria: Morning — noticed a 6x increase in tool invocation schema errors between 02:00-03:00 UTC. Dashboard spike on `invoke_schema_rejects`.
aj: ugh, saw that too. any correlation with rollout? last canary pushed at 01:45
maria: Canary was the new strict-validator change. I rolled it back at 03:10 but there are lingering rejects in the logs.
sanjay: quick question: are these rejects from the router (pre-routing) or from the adapter after invoke?
elaine: sample from logs:
```
ERROR tool_adapter: invocation rejected: schema_mismatch { expected: "ToolResponse", got: "string" }
metadata: { route: "low-latency", model: "redwood/fast-v2", tenant: "acme" }
```
aj: that payload shape looks like the LLM returned free text instead of the JSON object. Could be model drift or the strict validator is too strict.
maria: telemetry shows 95% of rejects were for 'missing fields' not type mismatches. suggests truncation or early stream cut.
tom: are we sure it's not a quota fallback rewriting the call? last week we had a fallback route that swapped to a smaller model which doesn't support tool call format.
elaine: checked routing logs: no fallback events for these tenants. route stayed on dedicated pool.
sanjay: ops-bot, can you surface the exact per-route firmware/validator versions for that window?
ops-bot: @sanjay requested: validator=2.3.1, router=1.9.0, adapter=3.0.0 in window 02:00-03:00 UTC
aj: validator 2.3.1 introduced `assert_strict_output:true` by default. That could explain spike.
maria: we need to classify errors in telemetry so dashboard can group by root-cause (model-output, truncation, validator-strictness, adapter-bug). Right now it's just "schema_reject".
tom: agree. Product/Console needs a more actionable classification so on-call knows whether to rollback or patch transformation.
elaine: proposal: add a heuristic classification pipeline that runs on the reject event:
- if missing required fields and token_count ~ max -> mark `likely_truncation`
- if top-level type mismatch and last_model_token_count < max -> `model_format`
- if validator version >= 2.3.1 and reject_type matches known patterns -> `validator_strict`
- else `adapter_or_router`
aj: can we enrich events with `prompt_hash` and `model_variant` so we can audit later?
sanjay: yes include `prompt_hash`, `seq_length`, `response_tokens`, `route_id`, `validator_version` in the reject event.
maria: UX ask: console should show suggested action per-classification: e.g., rollback validator toggle, increase max_tokens, or open adapter issue template.
tom: also add an immediate per-tenant signal to auto-route to a fallback tolerant path for N minutes if we see >X rejects/min for that tenant.
elaine: careful: auto-fallback could hide upstream model/data problems. Make it opt-in per-tenant.
aj: telemetry storage note: we should sample full payloads for at least 1% of rejects for offline debugging (sensitive fields redacted)
sanjay: telemetry volume will explode. let's attach only hashed prompts and a redacted sanitized payload when sampling.
ops-bot: logged action: create ticket "invoke-schema-classification-pipeline" assigned to eng-platform oncall. ticket #INF-4521
maria: timeline: can we get initial classification and dashboard tiles by EOW? need it for next oncall rotation.
tom: I'll pick up the classification heuristic. will create the lightweight job that annotates incoming reject events and writes to metrics pipeline.
elaine: I'll prototype console UX tiles and a contextual action dropdown: "suggested fix" -> shows 3 options and one-click rollback toggle for validator feature flag.
aj: I'll add the extra fields to the reject event and put a 1% sampling endpoint for full payloads behind a feature flag.
sanjay: ops: add alert rule: if tenant has >20 schema_rejects in 5m AND classification==validator_strict then page oncall.
ops-bot: alert rule created: "schema_rejects_strict_page" threshold=20/5m, route=eng-platform-oncall
maria: edge case — what if model returns valid JSON but violates business enum (e.g., status: "completee")? classification should surface `schema_violation_mismatch` vs `typo`.
aj: we can compute edit distance for enum fields in sampled payloads and flag likely typos.
tom: good. add that to heuristic list.
elaine: final ask: include a short ops playbook snippet in the dashboard flyout:
"If classification == validator_strict -> toggle `assert_strict_output` off for Canary Rollout slice, monitor 10m. If reduces rejects, open PR to add fallback parser. If classification == likely_truncation -> increase `max_tokens` or enable streaming-kv-cache."
maria: sounds good. please put drafts in the ticket and ping me for review.
aj: pinged.
tools-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback of validator toggle requested by @maria — queued 03:12 UTC
sanjay: thanks everyone. rolling this into the incident runbook.
maria: thanks — nice quick sync. :thumbsup:
